name: gut-intelligence-system
purpose: Compile parent-owned context and an approved science interpretation envelope into an ordinary-wellness family meal journey, weekly review, and qualified-coach handoff.
outputs: adaptations for school, travel, budget, and food acceptance
weekly pattern summary without medical interpretation
questions for a qualified coach or clinician
blocked_outputs: claims of prevention, treatment, cure, or guaranteed outcome

parent: whether a proposed plan is used

state.public_repository: Schemas, templates, fictional fixtures, and tests only.
state.private_runtime: Identifiable family profiles, longitudinal journey data, raw reports, consent records, and coach communication.
state.model_context: Minimum necessary, parent-reviewed, and sanitized. Raw reports are excluded.

termination: Stop plan generation when consent, child age band, allergy status, or required exclusions are unknown.
Stop and route to a qualified professional when the request involves symptoms, abnormal results, treatment, growth concerns, eating disorders, or a medically prescribed diet.
Reject any science input that lacks adapter identity, review date, evidence grade, and permitted-claim scope.
Do not generate a plan when exclusions leave no safe candidate set.
